source.agency_name: City occupational/license tax ordinances (Birmingham, Bessemer, Gadsden, Attalla, Opelika, Auburn)
source.note: Rates cross-checked against two independent secondary sources 2026-07-29 (city-tax aggregator listings and payroll-guide summaries); Gadsden's own city revenue page does not publish the numeric rate online, so it relies on secondary sourcing only — flagged here rather than silently treated as equally verified. Alabama has dozens of smaller municipalities with occupational tax not listed below; select "Other" for those.

local_tax_note: Some Alabama cities and counties levy a local occupational tax, typically 0.5%-2% of wages. Birmingham, Bessemer, Gadsden, Attalla, Opelika, and Auburn are now computed via the selector above; dozens of smaller Alabama municipalities with their own occupational tax are still not covered.
deviation_note: This is an estimate based on standard single-filer federal, FICA, and AL state calculations. Actual withholding may differ based on your W-4 elections, pre-tax deductions, and other factors. Alabama's standard deduction is income-graduated ($2,000-$4,000 for single filers depending on AGI); this estimate uses a flat $3,000 approximation.
